column1: # Haulnet strings, English source (ADR 0018). Format: KEY<TAB>text, \n = line break, # = comment.
# Placeholders like {server} must stay as they are; their order may change. Names (Haulnet, Photon Cloud,
# haulnet-server), addresses, ports and "accepting: false" are not translated.
# "#@max N" sets the length limit (characters, estimate) for the keys below it; the tests report longer texts.
# Region page rows (name on the left, ping or port on the right)
# Text popups: the visible title is one line at a large font, directly above the input field
# Message headers (text-popup headers are passed to the game, which does not show them)
# {city} is a city name from the server list, in one language: keep it outside the sentence (no grammatical case).

column2: {city}: no server answers its status check, accepts new games and runs a compatible version.

column1: # {reason} is one of the ADDRESS_ERROR texts below.

column2: {text} is not a server address ({reason}).\nUse host or host:port, for example play.example.org or 203.0.113.5:27100.
The name {host} does not resolve to an address.
{server} does not accept new games (its status says accepting: false).

column1: # {server} is a city name or a server address: keep it outside the sentence (no grammatical case).

column2: {server}: the server is updating and starts no new games until it is done. Try again in a few minutes.
